# Symbol table

One meaning per object. A domain keeps its own notation, so the same object
appears under several symbols and a reader crossing domains can see which
spellings refer to the same thing.

## Asset correlation

`obj.asset-correlation`, canonically $\rho$. The correlation between the latent asset returns of two obligors.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| credit | $R$ | asset correlation | the Basel formula's own notation |
| stats | $\rho$ | correlation |  |

## Regression coefficients

`obj.coefficients`, canonically $\beta$. The parameter vector of a linear or generalised linear predictor.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $\beta$ | GLM coefficients |  |
| credit | $\beta$ | scorecard coefficients |  |
| stats | $\beta$ | coefficients |  |
| ml | $\theta$ | parameters | network weights, where beta would imply linearity |

## Cohort index

`obj.cohort-index`, canonically $i$. The index of the period in which the exposure originated.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $i$ | accident period | the row of a run-off triangle |
| credit | $i$ | origination vintage | the row of a vintage curve or a roll-rate matrix |

## Credibility weight

`obj.credibility-weight`, canonically $Z$. The weight placed on a group's own experience against the wider population's, in a linear credibility estimate.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $Z$ | credibility factor | the classical Buhlmann form Z = n/(n+k), from WST 322 and SP8 |
| ml | $\alpha_k$ | credibility weight | subscripted deliberately: the trunk's own lecture 10 to 11 keeps bare alpha for a Bernoulli gate probability and names the classical Z as the one that would collide with it, so a future credit-tagged node meets check 1's remedy here the way the hazard's ml alias meets it in Task 4 |

## Development factor

`obj.development-factor`, canonically $f_j$. The ratio carrying a cohort from one development index to the next.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $f_j$ | link ratio | the chain ladder age-to-age factor |
| credit | $r_j$ | roll rate | the transition rate between delinquency buckets at development index j |

## Development index

`obj.development-index`, canonically $j$. The index of elapsed time since the cohort originated.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $j$ | development period | the column of a run-off triangle |
| credit | $j$ | months on book | months since origination, or months since default for a recovery profile |

## Discount factor

`obj.discount-factor`, canonically $v$. The present value of one unit payable in one period.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| actuarial | $v$ | discount factor | v = 1/(1+i). Collides with the general-insurance exposure weight, which is why exposure is canonically e_i here |
| fin-eng | $v$ | discount factor |  |

## Dispersion parameter

`obj.dispersion`, canonically $\varphi$. The dispersion parameter of an exponential dispersion family.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $\varphi$ | dispersion |  |
| stats | $\varphi$ | dispersion |  |

## Exposure

`obj.exposure`, canonically $e_i$. The amount at risk for observation i, which the response is measured against.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $v_i$ | exposure years |  |
| credit | $\mathrm{EAD}_i$ | exposure at default |  |
| ml | $e_i$ | offset |  |

## Hazard rate

`obj.hazard`, canonically $h(t)$. The instantaneous rate at which the event occurs, conditional on survival to t.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| life | $\mu_x$ | force of mortality | age-indexed and continuous |
| gi | $\lambda$ | claim intensity |  |
| credit | $h(t)$ | default hazard |  |
| stats | $\lambda(t)$ | hazard function |  |
| ml | $h(t)$ | hazard | deep survival models write the hazard as the credit and canonical spelling do, so no ml spelling is invented |

## Lifetime distribution function

`obj.lifetime-cdf`, canonically $F(t)$. The probability that the event has occurred by time t.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| life | ${}_tq_x$ | mortality probability |  |
| credit | $F(t)$ | cumulative default probability |  |
| stats | $F(t)$ | distribution function |  |

## Standard normal distribution function

`obj.normal-cdf`, canonically $\Phi(\cdot)$. The distribution function of a standard normal variate.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| credit | $N(\cdot)$ | normal distribution function | the Basel formula's own notation |
| stats | $\Phi(\cdot)$ | standard normal CDF |  |

## Standard normal quantile function

`obj.normal-quantile`, canonically $\Phi^{-1}(\cdot)$. The inverse of the standard normal distribution function.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| credit | $G(\cdot)$ | inverse normal | the Basel formula's own notation |
| stats | $\Phi^{-1}(\cdot)$ | normal quantile |  |

## Regularisation weight

`obj.regularisation`, canonically $\lambda_{\mathrm{reg}}$. The weight on a penalty term in a regularised objective.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| ml | $\lambda_{\mathrm{reg}}$ | regularisation weight | subscripted deliberately: bare lambda is the claim intensity in gi and the hazard function in stats, and once obj.hazard carries an ml alias a node spending both objects in ml would fail check 1 with no remedy |
| stats | $\lambda_{\mathrm{reg}}$ | penalty weight |  |

## Expected response

`obj.response-mean`, canonically $\mu$. The expectation of the response variable under the fitted model.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $\mu$ | expected claim frequency |  |
| stats | $\mu$ | mean |  |
| ml | $\hat{y}$ | prediction |  |

## Survival function

`obj.survival`, canonically $S(t)$. The probability that the event has not occurred by time t.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| life | ${}_tp_x$ | survival probability |  |
| credit | $S(t)$ | survival function |  |
| stats | $S(t)$ | survival function |  |

## Ultimate

`obj.ultimate`, canonically $U_i$. The total the cohort reaches once development is complete.

| Domain | Symbol | Called | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| gi | $U_i$ | ultimate claims |  |
| credit | $U_i$ | lifetime loss | or ultimate recovery where the array is a recovery profile |
